clinical_cohort_flow.png.title: Public clinical and biopsy denominators are distinct.
clinical_cohort_flow.png.claim_scope: Aggregate public cohort and specimen counts, patient-level public assay-availability reconciliation, and a reviewed source-column linkage for the same 15 post-hoc PFS-labeled biopsies; not independent validation, predictive utility, or overall-survival evidence.

replication_signal_robustness.png.title: The same-cohort replication signal is not robust to score definition.
replication_signal_robustness.png.caption: Hedges g estimates and pointwise, unadjusted 95% stratified percentile-bootstrap intervals for seven score definitions anchored by KEGG hsa03030 and Reactome R-HSA-69306. Every interval includes no effect; p values are exact two-sided allocation tests.
replication_signal_robustness.png.claim_scope: score-definition sensitivity within the same 15 patients

mechanism_evidence_chain.png.title: POLA1 perturbation supports an experiment, not a clinical combination.
mechanism_evidence_chain.png.caption: Triplicate relative-growth measurements compare siPOLA1, prexasertib, and the combination in two parental HGSOC lineages and their acquired-resistant derivatives; the open diamond is a descriptive Bliss reference, not formal synergy.
mechanism_evidence_chain.png.claim_scope: preclinical hypothesis support only; ST1926 mediation, synergy, exposure feasibility, tumor selectivity, and clinical benefit are not established

prexasertib_exposure_boundary.png.title: Public PK supports regimen-level exposure, not patient-level underexposure.
prexasertib_exposure_boundary.png.caption: External phase-1 geometric mean AUC(0-72) with reported CV and PK n; the horizontal line is a xenograft-derived target, not a clinical efficacy threshold.
prexasertib_exposure_boundary.png.claim_scope: Regimen-level exposure plausibility only; no participant-level underexposure or exposure-response inference.

clinical_safety_burden.png.title: Severe prexasertib toxicity is predominantly hematologic.
clinical_safety_burden.png.caption: Grade 3/4 treatment-related adverse events among 49 treated participants, with computed Wilson 95% intervals and reported dose-reduction, discontinuation, and on-treatment-death counts.
clinical_safety_burden.png.claim_scope: Observed prexasertib monotherapy safety only; no exposure-toxicity, combination-safety, or therapeutic-index claim.
